subject: stats: optimize build topn and histogram (#63285)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for PR #63285. Key changes are in `pkg/statistics/builder.go`: TopN collection now uses a bounded min-heap with per-value sample index ranges, and histogram building skips TopN ranges via a sequential range checker (avoiding in-place sample slice mutation). Planner defaults (`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go`) now reference shared statistics constants for default TopN/bucket counts. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, or runtime stability for the touched planner/statistics paths.
